page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on KVM hypervisor technology and the x86_64 instruction set architecture. It is powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor operating at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs paired with 256.0 GB of memory, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance configuration omits bundled local NVMe storage and discrete GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage volumes for persistent disk operations. Network connectivity is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth capability, facilitating high-capacity data transfer across cloud resources. The environment provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring explicit networking configuration for external routing.

By offering a balanced compute-to-memory footprint without local disk overhead, ecs.g5.16xlarge provides qualitative cost efficiency for scaled workloads requiring large parallel compute capacity and memory allocation. The absence of local NVMe drives requires attachment of block storage services for disk-bound tasks. This server type is suited for enterprise web application hosting, mid-tier database hosting, continuous integration pipelines, and distributed application processing.
